title: Visitors Laugh Away Troubles at the HaHaHouse Museum
titleZh: 游客在“哈哈”博物馆中笑逐颜开，烦恼全消
credits: Lajla Veselica reported this story for Agence-France Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: A new museum of laughter in Croatia is offering to help people deal with the negativity of modern life.
sentences.zh: 克罗地亚一座新的幽默博物馆正致力于帮助人们应对现代生活中的消极情绪。

sentences.en: Visitors to the HaHaHouse in the Croatian capital Zagreb walk into a little cloud of white smoke when they step inside.
sentences.zh: 游客走进克罗地亚首都萨格勒布的"哈哈屋"时，一踏入其中便会笼罩在一小团白色烟雾里。

sentences.en: Its purpose is to blow away their worries before they climb into a "giant washing machine".
sentences.zh: 它的目的是在游客登上"巨型洗衣机"之前，吹散他们的烦恼。

sentences.en: Then they move down a twisting slide into a space filled with little white balls where their trip to a happier place starts.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们顺着一条蜿蜒的滑梯下滑，进入一个摆满白色小球的房间，而这段通往更快乐之地的旅程就此开始。

sentences.en: Forty-three-year-old Andrea Golubic is the museum’s creator.
sentences.zh: 43岁的安德里亚·戈卢比奇是这座博物馆的创建者。

sentences.en: Golubic said she got the idea during the COVID-19 pandemic.
sentences.zh: 戈卢比奇说，她是在新冠疫情疫情期间萌生了这个想法。

sentences.en: At that time, many people were feeling down, depressed and alone: "I realized that I had a mission -- to heal people with laughter."
sentences.zh: 那时，许多人感到沮丧、抑郁和孤独："我意识到自己肩负着一项使命——用笑声治愈人们。"

sentences.en: The idea "came straight from the heart", Golubic told the French News Agency (AFP).
sentences.zh: 戈卢比奇告诉法新社（AFP），这个想法"发自内心"。

sentences.en: She had ideas for many of the museum elements in one day: “that's how the HaHaHouse began."
sentences.zh: 她只用了一天时间就想出了博物馆许多元素的想法："'哈哈屋'就是这样诞生的。"

sentences.en: Golubic said a picture of her when she was seven-year-old inspired her.
sentences.zh: 戈卢比奇说，一张自己七岁时的照片启发了她。

sentences.en: “I was constantly joking as a kid," she added.
sentences.zh: "我小时候总是讲笑话，"她补充道。

sentences.en: Visitors press a button to be "disinfected from negativity" as soon as they step inside the museum, which has eight interactive zones, or areas.
sentences.zh: 游客一踏进博物馆，只需按下按钮，就能"消除消极情绪"，该博物馆设有八个互动区域。

sentences.en: One has rubber chickens singing cheerfully.
sentences.zh: 其中一个区域里有橡胶鸡在欢快地歌唱。

sentences.en: They sing songs like ABBA's "Dancing Queen."
sentences.zh: 它们演唱着像ABBA乐队的《Dancing Queen》这样的歌曲。

sentences.en: There is a karaoke room with distorted voices and a "Sumo Arena" for wrestling in puffed up clothes.
sentences.zh: 还有一个配有变声设备的卡拉OK室，以及一个供人们穿着充气服装进行摔跤的"相扑竞技场"。

sentences.en: There is also some serious history of humor from ancient to modern times told through theatre, film or the internet.
sentences.zh: 此外，这里还通过戏剧、电影或互联网，讲述了从古代到现代的幽默发展史。

sentences.en: The museum also explains different kinds of humor.
sentences.zh: 这座博物馆还介绍了不同类型的幽默。

sentences.en: These include word play, slapstick, dark humor and satire.
sentences.zh: 这些包括文字游戏、闹剧、黑色幽默和讽刺。

sentences.en: Golubic said the HaHaHouse is popular with everyone from small children to older people.
sentences.zh: 戈卢比奇说，"哈哈屋"深受从幼童到长者的各类人群喜爱。

sentences.en: Adults say it is a good excuse to act like a child.
sentences.zh: 成年人说，这是一个像孩子一样玩耍的好借口。

sentences.en: "All those who still feel a bit of childish joy and embrace their inner child, will recharge themselves," she said.
sentences.zh: "所有那些仍然感受到一丝童真喜悦、拥抱内心孩子的人，都会给自己充电，"她说。

sentences.en: Retiree Bruno Dadic told AFP he was pleased by his visit "as there is never enough humor in life.
sentences.zh: 退休人士布鲁诺·达迪克告诉法新社，他对此次参观感到高兴，"因为生活中幽默永远不够。

sentences.en: "Laughter is a medicine for the soul," he said.
sentences.zh: "笑声是灵魂的良药，"他说。

sentences.en: Aleksandar Suka celebrated his fifth birthday with a visit.
sentences.zh: 亚历山大·苏卡以一次参观庆祝了他的五岁生日。

sentences.en: Visiting with his mother, the little boy said he liked lying on the "Bed of Nails" since they tickled him.
sentences.zh: 与母亲一同参观的小男孩说他喜欢躺在"钉子床"上，因为它们挠得他发痒。

sentences.en: Singer Zorica Bucic, from the coastal town of Split, said the museum was just right for our times.
sentences.zh: 来自沿海城市斯普利特的歌手佐里卡·布契克说，这家博物馆正好契合我们的时代。

sentences.en: "Entering here is like entering childhood, being relieved of all problems,” she said.
sentences.zh: "走进这里就像走进童年，摆脱所有烦恼，"她说。

sentences.en: Bucic added that if you could come to museum often, you would not need to visit a psychologist.
sentences.zh: 布契克补充说，如果你能经常来这家博物馆，就不需要去看心理医生了。

sentences.en: Psychologist Petar Kraljevic told AFP that laughter is a kind of weapon which gives people strength to face their problems.
sentences.zh: 心理学家彼得·克拉列维奇告诉法新社，笑声是一种能给人力量去面对问题的武器。

sentences.en: He said that if doctors could advise their patients to have "three hours of laughter” a day, people would feel much better.
sentences.zh: 他说，如果医生能建议患者每天"笑三个小时"，人们会感觉好得多。

sentences.en: I’m John Russell.
sentences.zh: 我是约翰·罗素。
